name: hosting
title: Hosting
description: Apps and functions on Workers for Platforms - static assets and server code in one deploy, served at your subdomain.

SENTRY_DSN.hint: Error reporting; empty disables it. A var, not a secret - a DSN is public by design.

HOSTING_DOMAIN.hint: Apex domain apps serve under (e.g. cfbase.dev). Empty disables the serving path.

DISPATCH_NAMESPACE.hint: Workers for Platforms dispatch namespace name the DISPATCH binding targets.

WAE_DATASET.hint: Analytics Engine dataset for per-request analytics; reads need CF_ANALYTICS_API_TOKEN.
